description: Experience the ultimate  adventure! Features immersive quests and optimized performance with Rubidium.
body:
# 🌌 PokeGalaxia — Pixelmon

Welcome to the ultimate Pixelmon 1.16.5 experience! This modpack has been carefully designed to offer the perfect balance between exploration, Pokémon battling, and highly optimized performance. 

Whether you're looking to catch 'em all, complete challenging quests, or simply enjoy a vibrant world with your friends, this pack has everything you need to play without lag.

## ✨ Main Features

* 🐾 **The Pixelmon Universe:** Enjoy Pixelmon 1.16.5 with fully configured generation, battle, and catching mechanics.
* 🗺️ **Quests & Adventure:** Ready to be integrated with complex quest systems and custom narratives to add more depth to your gameplay.
* ⚡ **Optimized Performance:** We have included a hand-picked selection of optimization mods, including Rubidium, to ensure high FPS, smooth chunk loading, and efficient memory usage.

## ❓ Why choose this Modpack?
Unlike other bulky packs, this is a lightweight, performance-focused client specifically tailored for the PokeGalaxia community. It guarantees a stable connection, fast loading times, and seamless gameplay for both low-end and high-end PCs.

## 🚀 How to Start

1. Download the modpack using the Modrinth App (recommended for automatic updates).
2. Allocate at least 4GB of RAM to your profile for optimal performance.
3. Jump into the world, choose your starter, and begin your journey!

## 📜 Featured Mods
* Pixelmon
* Rubidium
